issues.issue: The top-level business-type cost-type lines (disbursements[9]-[16]) all carry function 'utilities', but their Total-column amounts include Golf Fund spending, which is culture/recreation. The detail lines tag Golf as culture/recreation, so the two disagree.

The detail gives the same label Utility Charges for Water/Sewer and Recreation Fees for Golf, but the combined top-level line keeps the generic category. This is defensible because the line is a mix; flagged because the same label has different categories.

Year-to-year check: Rushville_FY2024 prints the proprietary beginning cash as 278,719 (FY2024 trimmed p7: Water 147,524, Sewer 127,389, Golf 3,806). The FY2023 ending is 278,979 (Golf 4,066). The 260 difference is in the Golf column; FY2024 printed Golf's FY2023 beginning figure (3,806), and no restatement is printed. FY2023 is extracted correctly as printed. Other balances tie: fund balance 1,277,326 and business-type net position 973,097 equal the FY2024 beginning figures.
